description: This file defines classes and objects related to subquery execution within Spark SQL, including ScalarSubquery, InSubqueryExec, and a rule for planning subqueries.

classes.name: ExecSubqueryExpression
classes.description: Abstract base class for subquery expressions used in SparkPlan.

classes.name: ScalarSubquery
classes.description: Represents a scalar subquery returning a single value, used inside SparkPlan.

classes.name: InSubqueryExec
classes.description: Represents an in-subquery predicate, used for dynamic partition pruning.

classes.name: PlanSubqueries
classes.description: A rule that plans subqueries present in a SparkPlan.

methods.name: hasSubquery
methods.description: Checks if an expression contains a subquery.

methods.name: updateResult
methods.description: Fills the expression with the collected result from the executed plan.

methods.name: withNewPlan
methods.description: Creates a new instance with a different subquery plan.

methods.name: initQueryContext
methods.description: Initializes the query context for ScalarSubquery.

methods.name: doGenCode
methods.description: Generates code for the subquery expression.

methods.name: toLiteral
methods.description: Converts the subquery result to a Literal.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns the result array for InSubqueryExec.

methods.name: prepareResult
methods.description: Prepares the result for evaluation, handling broadcast if necessary.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Transforms SparkPlan to plan subqueries within it.
